subject: PLVS dependency license-material remediation
status: Engineering remediation implemented locally; historical supplements published. This is not a blanket legal compliance certification.

delivery.originalHistoricalAssets: Retained. Asset identities, sizes and reported SHA-256 digests were compared before and after every release-note edit.
delivery.supplementPlacement: Dedicated materials release because immutable desktop releases prohibit adding assets; original release notes link to each matching archive.

currentEngineeringControls: Exact locked runtime package versions, declared licenses and original notice fingerprints require explicit review.
Build and development tool versions and license declarations are reviewed separately.
Model/native input hashes, installer tool version and Rust standard-library notices are checked.
Original native/runtime and package notices are included in desktop distribution resources.
Complete packaged license bytes must match reviewed files; marker-only truncation is rejected.
Source downloads must exist and match recorded hashes before release/preview publication.
TEN VAD reintroduction is blocked by the restricted-package policy.
An independent CI license job runs even for website-only changes. These repository changes take effect in hosted CI after being committed and pushed.

ffmpeg.current: Windows r2 rebuilt from a clean unmodified upstream 7.1 archive. Source, recipe, toolchain and binary hashes are published together. Existing macOS binaries retained with original workflow provenance.
ffmpeg.historical: The exact old Windows source checkout/build provenance could not be recovered. The historical source supplement records this gap and must not be represented as verified corresponding source for that binary.

tenVad.finding: The Apache-2.0 wrapper declaration omitted additional upstream model restrictions, including competition with Agora and end-user use.
tenVad.userDecision: Keep historical downloads available; append corrected terms and an upgrade advisory. No installers were overwritten or hidden.
tenVad.remaining: Applicability of the additional terms to historical distribution/use remains unresolved. Disclosure and continued availability do not establish compliance.

historicalCoverage.method: Exact source commits and lockfiles; all registry Cargo packages as a conservative superset, npm production packages and Tailwind, plus original vendored/font notices and matching ONNX notices.
limitations: Lockfiles are not binary-level bills of materials.
Historical installer/compiler runtime versions and every native binary feature were not fully reconstructed.
Some original package archives omit standalone license files; declarations and available source headers are retained without inventing attribution.
